description: List curated BuildFeed videos, optionally filtered by category and sorted by recency, views, likes, or quality score. Returns compact video records (title, channel, categories, view/like counts, quality score) without transcript or description text. Use this to browse recent/top videos; use search_videos instead when looking for a specific topic.

category.description: Restrict to one category: AI, VC, Startup, Product, Design, or Tools.

limit.description: Max videos to return (default 20, hard cap 50).

since.description: Only videos published on or after this ISO 8601 date. Searches the full archive; videos outside the rolling cache have qualityScore 0 and commentCount 0.

sort.description: Sort order: recent (default), views, likes, or quality.

name: list_videos
